summary: Test-writing phase for issue #39. Committed: solver parity corpus fixture (10 cases incl. 3 ties, 5 exclusion cases, 1 all-excluded, zero-weight and all-five-channel cases) + SolverParityCorpusTests (corpus integrity, per-candidate score parity, earliest-wins tie-break selection, CompositionSolver fast-path selection); OpenAPIClientAdoptionTests (red guard: Package.swift must declare swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime); OpenAPIMigrationContractTests (pins /api/v1 request shape, snake_case envelope decode, 401/badStatus/malformed mapping through PaletteAPIClient); docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. Fixture expectations were independently verified with a Python reimplementation of WeightedSquaredError + best_match semantics (all 10 cases reproduce exactly). swift test could NOT be executed: no Swift toolchain exists in this container (bin/lint detects and skips). The two adoption-guard tests are intentionally red at this head (missing behavior); implementation lands in the separate Paid implementation run.
